part.text: This is a Next.js 16 App Router project with TypeScript and ES modules. I'll create the `middleware.ts` file at the project root.
Now let me typecheck to verify correctness.

Typecheck passes. Created `middleware.ts:1` at the project root.

The middleware logs `Request pathname: <path>` to the console, generates a unique ID via `crypto.randomUUID()` (available in both Node.js and Edge runtimes), and sets the `x-request-id` header on every response. The `/:path*` matcher covers all paths.

Note: HTTP headers are case-insensitive, and Next.js normalizes them to lowercase, so `x-request-id` is equivalent to `X-Request-Id`.
